entities.summary: Anwar Ibrahim, a notable figure in the history of Malaysia, associated with Mahathir Era and Modernization (1997–2003). Preceded by Petronas Twin Towers completed — world's tallest buildings and Proton Saga launched as Malaysia's first national car. Their legacy influenced Mahathir imposes capital controls defying IMF orthodoxy during the Asian crisis and Anwar Ibrahim sacked and arrested, sparking the Reformasi movement.
